items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: So he comes at night and he sits in, he loves Phineas, and we began to have

ctx.x: So one night -- no, one afternoon, I happened to turn the TV on, and I saw a guy -- how things work -- with a white suit on, with his back turned, directing the band, and he's shaking his buns and carrying on, so I said, "I know that guy. I know him." So when he turned around it was a Maurice Chevalier spectacular, with Michel Legrand directing the orchestra. So when I turned around, I said, "That's Michel." So I went to the phone and I called CBS, backstage, and I said, "This is Kenny Clarke, I'd like to speak…

a lot of fun. He was singing and having fun. So just before he left he says, "Listen, would you like to come back to Paris?" I said, "I would love nothing better." He said, "Well, my uncle Henan Jacques Eliam (PHONETIC), is forming an orchestra. He's going to play nothing but jazz." So I said, "Wonderful." He says, "Will you give me your word?" I said, "Yeah, you have my word, Michel." So he left. Two weeks later I had a contract from his uncle, and that was like in August, in September I was gone. I came back in…
